body: Follow-up to my request: `aida burndown plan` lists TASK-1537 as Ready to fan out, but `aida do TASK-1537` refuses because no execution mode is set and mode assignment is advisor-owned. Please reconcile this discrepancy and set the appropriate mode/queue state for the four claimed-ready items (TASK-1537, STORY-1476, STORY-1484, STORY-1498), especially before any dispatch. Product will not infer the mode.
